body: Never forget when Drake’s dad accidentally gave out his email to thousands of people on Instagram Live Who remembers this Dennis Graham shared the address while people were watching, then kept telling everyone not to send him any emails. Drake immediately saw the problem and warned his dad he was going to get hacked The funniest part was Dennis trying to set a boundary after already giving the whole Live his contact information.

source_caption_text:
Never forget when Drake’s dad accidentally gave out his email to thousands of people on Instagram Live 😭😂

Who remembers this😂

Dennis Graham shared the address while people were watching, then kept telling everyone not to send him any emails. Drake immediately saw the problem and warned his dad he was going to get hacked 💀

The funniest part was Dennis trying to set a boundary after already giving the whole Live his contact information. He really expected thousands of strangers to hear his email address and respectfully leave his inbox alone 😂

Drake went from being on Live with his dad to having to explain why you probably shouldn’t announce your email to the entire internet 😭
